CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_following(p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, username text, full_name text, school text, avatar_path text, solved_count bigint, trying_count bigint, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select s.*,count(*) over() from public.following f join public.community_summary s on s.user_id=f.followed_id
 where f.follower_id=auth.uid() order by f.created_at desc,f.followed_id
 limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,50),1),50) offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_friend_status(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when auth.uid() is null then 'guest' when auth.uid()=p_user_id then 'self'
 when f.status='accepted' then 'friend' when f.requested_by=auth.uid() then 'outgoing'
 when f.status='pending' then 'incoming' else 'none' end
 from (select 1) dummy left join public.friendships f on f.user_low=least(auth.uid(),p_user_id) and f.user_high=greatest(auth.uid(),p_user_id);
$function$

functions.arguments: p_kind text, p_offset integer, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_friends(p_kind text DEFAULT 'friend'::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, username text, full_name text, school text, avatar_path text, solved_count bigint, trying_count bigint, relationship text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with involved as (
  select s.*,case when f.status='accepted' then 'friend' when f.requested_by=auth.uid() then 'outgoing' else 'incoming' end as relationship
  from public.friendships f join public.community_summary s on s.user_id=case when f.user_low=auth.uid() then f.user_high else f.user_low end
  where auth.uid() in (f.user_low,f.user_high)
 ) select i.*,count(*) over() from involved i where i.relationship=p_kind
 order by i.solved_count desc,i.username nulls last,i.user_id
 limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,50),1),50) offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_leaderboard(p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, username text, full_name text, school text, avatar_path text, solved_count bigint, trying_count bigint, rank bigint, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with ranked as (select s.*,dense_rank() over(order by s.solved_count desc) as rank from public.community_summary s)
 select r.*, count(*) over() from ranked r
 where coalesce(r.username,'') ilike '%'||left(coalesce(p_search,''),100)||'%'
    or r.full_name ilike '%'||left(coalesce(p_search,''),100)||'%'
    or r.school ilike '%'||left(coalesce(p_search,''),100)||'%'
 order by r.solved_count desc,r.username nulls last,r.user_id
 limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,50),1),50) offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_learning_profile(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'profile',to_jsonb(pr)||jsonb_build_object('bio',p.bio,'joined_at',u.created_at),
  'progress',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('problem_id',pg.problem_id,'status',pg.status,'first_solved_at',pg.first_solved_at,'first_attempted_at',pg.first_attempted_at))
   from public.progress pg join public.problem_catalog pc using(problem_id) where pg.user_id=p_user_id and pg.status in ('trying','solved')),'[]'::jsonb),
  'plan',coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('started',lr.value ? 'startedAt','paused',coalesce(lr.value->'paused'='true'::jsonb,false),'completedDays',case when jsonb_typeof(lr.value->'completedDays')='array' then (select count(distinct day_index) from (select case when jsonb_typeof(d.value)='number' and d.value::text ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' then d.value::text::integer end as day_index from jsonb_array_elements(lr.value->'completedDays') d(value)) valid_days where day_index between 1 and 100) else 0 end)
   from public.learning_records lr where lr.user_id=p_user_id and lr.kind='plan' and lr.key='olympiad-100-v1'),'{}'::jsonb))
 from public.get_public_profile(p_user_id) pr join public.profiles p on p.user_id=pr.user_id join auth.users u on u.id=p.user_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.study_group_detail(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not study_private.can_view(p_group_id) then raise exception 'Энэ группт хандах эрхгүй.' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('group',(select to_jsonb(g) from public.study_groups g where id=p_group_id),
   'can_manage',study_private.can_manage(p_group_id),'is_member',study_private.is_member(p_group_id),
   'members',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user_id',m.user_id,'role',m.role,
       'username',p.username,'full_name',p.full_name,'first_name',p.first_name,'last_name',p.last_name)
       order by m.role,p.username nulls last,m.user_id)
     from public.study_group_members m left join public.profiles p on p.user_id=m.user_id
     where m.group_id=p_group_id),'[]'::jsonb));
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.study_list_groups()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Эхлээд нэвтэрнэ үү.' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('site_admin',public.is_admin(),'groups',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(item order by is_mine desc,created_at desc) from (
     select g.created_at,m.user_id is not null as is_mine,
       to_jsonb(g)||jsonb_build_object('my_role',m.role,'member_count',
         (select count(*) from public.study_group_members all_m where all_m.group_id=g.id)) as item
     from public.study_groups g
     left join public.study_group_members m on m.group_id=g.id and m.user_id=auth.uid()
     where study_private.can_view(g.id)
   ) s),'[]'::jsonb));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.study_report_data(p_group_id uuid, p_dates date[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not study_private.can_view(p_group_id) then raise exception 'Энэ группын тайланг харах эрхгүй.' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 if p_dates is null or cardinality(p_dates) not between 1 and 62 or array_position(p_dates,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_dates) d where not isfinite(d)) then
   raise exception '1–62 өдөр сонгоно уу.' using errcode='22023';
 end if;
 return coalesce((with days as (select distinct unnest(p_dates) as day), roster as (
   select user_id from public.study_group_members where group_id=p_group_id
   union select user_id from public.study_reports where group_id=p_group_id and report_date=any(p_dates)
   union select user_id from public.study_teacher_notes where group_id=p_group_id and report_date=any(p_dates)
 ) select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'user_id',roster.user_id,'username',p.username,'last_name',p.last_name,'first_name',p.first_name,
     'full_name',p.full_name,'school',p.school,'report_date',days.day,'is_member',m.user_id is not null,
     'has_report',r.user_id is not null,'solved_problems',coalesce(r.solved_problems,''),
     'problem_count',r.problem_count,'difficulty',coalesce(r.difficulty,''),'topics',coalesce(r.topics,''),
     'notes',coalesce(r.notes,''),'revision',r.revision,'updated_at',r.updated_at,
     'can_edit',study_private.can_manage(p_group_id) or (roster.user_id=auth.uid() and m.user_id is not null),
     'teacher_note',coalesce(t.note,''),'teacher_revision',t.revision,'has_teacher_note',t.user_id is not null,
     'can_edit_teacher',study_private.can_manage(p_group_id))
     order by days.day,p.username nulls last,roster.user_id)
   from days cross join roster
   left join public.profiles p on p.user_id=roster.user_id
   left join public.study_group_members m on m.group_id=p_group_id and m.user_id=roster.user_id
   left join public.study_reports r on r.group_id=p_group_id and r.user_id=roster.user_id and r.report_date=days.day
   left join public.study_teacher_notes t on t.group_id=p_group_id and t.user_id=roster.user_id and t.report_date=days.day
 ),'[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tutorial_image_paths(p_body jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(path text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select distinct value->>'path' from jsonb_path_query(coalesce(p_body,'{}'::jsonb),'$.** ? (@.type == "image")') x(value)
 where value->>'path' ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,80}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.webp$';
$function$

functions.name: tutorial_require_text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tutorial_require_text(p_value jsonb, p_max integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_value is null or jsonb_typeof(p_value)<>'string' or length(btrim(p_value#>>'{}')) not between 1 and p_max then
  raise exception 'Tutorial text is missing or too long.' using errcode='22023';
 end if;
end;
$function$

functions.name: valid_task_url
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_task_url(p_url text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_url is not null and length(p_url)<=1000 and p_url ~ '^https://[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9.-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?([/:?#][^[:space:]]*)?$';
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION study_private.can_manage(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null and (public.is_admin() or exists (
   select 1 from public.study_group_members where group_id=p_group_id and user_id=auth.uid() and role='admin'));
$function$

functions.name: can_view
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION study_private.can_view(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null and exists (
   select 1 from public.study_groups where id=p_group_id and
     (visibility='public' or public.is_admin() or study_private.is_member(p_group_id)));
$function$

functions.name: is_member
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION study_private.is_member(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null and exists (
   select 1 from public.study_group_members where group_id=p_group_id and user_id=auth.uid());
$function$
